userdoc.notice: Stores ERC20 tokens of an ecosystem reserve and allows to dispose of them via approval or transfer dynamics or streaming capabilities. Modification of Sablier https://github.com/sablierhq/sablier/blob/develop/packages/protocol/contracts/Sablier.sol Original can be found also deployed on https://etherscan.io/address/0xCD18eAa163733Da39c232722cBC4E8940b1D8888 Modifications: - Sablier "pulls" the funds from the creator of the stream at creation. In the Aave case, we already have the funds. - Anybody can create streams on Sablier. Here, only the funds admin (Aave governance via controller) can - Adapted codebase to Solidity 0.8.11, mainly removing SafeMath and CarefulMath to use native safe math - Same as with creation, on Sablier the `sender` and `recipient` can cancel a stream. Here, only fund admin and recipient
